representation_strength_threshold.proposal: Paired 95% lower bound above -50 relative Elo versus frozen Hero1 at one-pass inference with each checkpoint's training-matched input contract; freeze opening/compute protocol before architecture selection.

experiments.name: Inference-aligned policy validation versus observed play
experiments.result_summary: Raw BT4 has lowest CE on both shared validation pools. HH-002 native/DFM1 improve on Hero1 but remain worse than raw. HH-002 DFM8 has worse CE than old Hero1 DFM8 yet wins their direct match; CE alone is not a monotonic strength measure. All 14 aggregations validated; historical Hero1 metrics reproduce.
experiments.scope: Raw BT4 and old/history-trained Hero native/DFM1/DFM8 on shared 8128-position Hero and 8192-position sequential pools. No training or new games; compare legal CE with existing play results.

experiments.name: History-trained Hero searchless play and matched weight movement
experiments.result_summary: HH-002 p1 scores 65.82% versus Hero1 p1 and 30.47% versus full-history raw BT4. Native policy scores 48.24% versus raw (inconclusive). Eight passes score 35.35% versus one pass. Backbone movement is 18.35% larger, concentrated in embedding movement (+36.53%); transformer blocks move 0.85% less. All 1792 main and 96 smoke games completed without faults/cap draws/coverage misses; no promotion to search.
experiments.scope: Seven fixed 128-pair searchless comparisons: p1, p8 and native policy versus Hero1 and full-history raw BT4, plus p8 versus p1. Development only; no search or promotion.

experiments.name: Hero recipe with full history on verified reduced original data
experiments.scope: 553 updates, original recipe, contracted original examples; W&B and common-pool historical loss comparison. Playing strength is a separate EV-006 evaluation.

experiments.name: Hero 1 recipe with full history on the original examples
experiments.scope: Matched 554-update fresh run, same original examples/targets/order; restore current and future history, including Chess960. No data substitution.

experiments.name: Hero1 versus full-history raw BT4 with matched current-only control
experiments.result_summary: Hero1 p1 scored 18.75% versus full-history raw BT4 and 93.75% versus current-only raw on the same 128 pairs. Hero1 native policy scored 41.80% versus full-history raw (95% interval 29.79%-53.80%). Zero faults/cap draws/coverage misses. Missing history substantially weakened the old raw anchor.
experiments.scope: Hero1 p1 and native policy versus raw BT4 with full history; matched p1/current-only control. No training, no search, no SOTA claim.

experiments.name: Retained terminal Hero versus matched-recipe Hero1 reference
experiments.scope: Original 27679-update Hero versus 554-update replicate: matched policy validation, p1/p8/native arena, no training or search.

experiments.question: Does generating future JEPA state embeddings and decoding legal moves from them provide a more useful prediction-to-policy coupling than categorical DFM?
